rating.summary: A well-selected report: the overview groups the countries and adds the pay rise, and the working-hours exception is spotted. Figures are accurate and the comparisons are precise.
rating.strength: "Japan, where teachers worked 54 hours a week, the longest of all" turns the third column into a key feature instead of a list.
